requirement: Soft delete an antibiotic and cascade the soft delete to every dosage that belongs to it inside one transaction, leaving other antibiotics and their dosages untouched, and report an unknown ID as not found.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic exists for the target ID
Two dosages belong to the target antibiotic and one live control antibiotic exists
The target antibiotic has no dosage
The target ID matches no live antibiotic

inputs.text: Delete request for an antibiotic with two dosages
Delete request for an antibiotic with no dosage
Delete request with an unknown antibiotic ID

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; IsDeleted and DeletedAt are set on the antibiotic
Every dosage of the deleted antibiotic is soft-deleted in the same transaction
Other antibiotics and their dosages stay live
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic not found' error; nothing is deleted

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing antibiotic is returned as a failed Result
